g.text: Flat actual holonomy: jets, neighbouring fibres and the reduced norm
Original codimension q = 1; all actual germs, source counts and the full positive lift are retained.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Four intervals shown; the full flat family approaches zero.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle
font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: C. The actual zero isotropy survives every formal jet — FGJ.5, FGJ.8, FGJ.10
Negative source fibres have one unit arrow. Their unit sequence has two distinct arrow-space limits:
The coherent lift is sqrt(Dw), with central phase 1; inverse phase 1 and final right C1 remain.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: D. Two different reduced norms — FGJ.13–FGJ.15
Canonical reduced labelled-action collapse would send v tensor P to v and violate contractivity.

text.style: font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #344c59

g.text: The reduced germ character is even. The original degree-one normal graph class still requires its own proof.
